title: Build an Integration
snippet:
Close’s [REST API](/api) supports everything from a simple internal script to a full product integration used by thousands of Close customers.

There are two ways to authenticate with the Close REST API or MCP server.
- **API keys** — A key is tied to a specific user and organization. Great for scripts, internal tools, import jobs, and automations. Generate one in **Settings → Developer → API Keys** and then follow [API keys](/api/overview/api-key-authentication) to authenticate your requests.
- **OAuth 2.0** — Lets each user authorize your app to act on their behalf. Strongly recommended for user-facing integrations that multiple users will authenticate to. See [Creating an OAuth App](/integrations/create-an-oauth-app) to get started and then follow [Authentication with OAuth](/api/overview/oauth-authentication) to implement the request flow.

## Dev/test organization
If you need a separate Close organization for development and testing:
- **Already a Close user** — You can create a free secondary organization. See [Secondary organization](https://help.close.com/docs/secondary-organization) for instructions.
- **Not a Close user** — Integration partners who don’t use Close in their own sales process can request a free Dev organization by emailing [support@close.com](mailto:support@close.com) with a description of your OAuth app, the overall workflow, and your expected release timeline. Dev organizations work identically to standard Close organizations but have no subscription fees.
Your OAuth app continues to work regardless of whether your Close account’s subscription is active, expired, or canceled.

title: help.close.com/docs/ai-credits
snippet:
Close uses a credit-based system to power advanced AI features. Credits are pooled at the account level, reset monthly, and do not roll over.
Close has three separate billing areas: your **CRM plan**, **telephony usage** (calls, SMS, and phone numbers), and **AI credits**. These are billed and invoiced separately. This article covers AI credits only. See [Calling and SMS Usage](/account-management/variable-usage-costs-calling-sms-phone-numbers-ai-tools) for telephony rates.
Some AI features are **always free** — they never consume credits and keep working even if your balance hits zero.
## What Uses Credits
### Free — No Credits Required
These features are available and never consume credits:
| Feature                                     | Plans            | Notes                                                 |
| ------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| **Notetaker**                               | All              | Call transcripts                                      |
| **Chloe Chat**                              | All              | Conversational AI assistant for working your pipeline |
| **AI Search**                               | All              | Natural language search across your CRM data          |
| **AI Knowledge Sources**                    | All              | Knowledge base Chloe can query during calls           |
| **Lead Summaries**                          | Growth and above | AI-generated summaries of lead activity               |
| **Email Thread Summaries**                  | Growth and above | AI-generated summaries of email conversations         |
| **AI Rewrite / Smart Reply / Draft Assist** | Growth and above | AI-assisted email editing and reply suggestions       |
| **Suggested Actions**                       | Growth and above | AI-recommended next steps on leads                    |

| Plan                          | Credits per User | Cap      | Max Credits |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------- | -------- | ----------- |
| Solo / Base / Starter         | 500              | 1 user   | 500         |
| Essentials / Startup / Basic  | 1,000            | 10 users | 10,000      |
| Growth / Professional         | 1,500            | 10 users | 15,000      |
